Subject: Internal Physical Verification of Stores, Library, Workshop and Departments/Sections.

In order to ensure proper upkeep, maintenance and physical verification of all assets, infrastructure, equipment, furniture, tools, machinery, records and other materials in the institution, all Heads of Departments (HoDs), Incharges and Sectional Heads are hereby directed to carry out a comprehensive internal physical verification of their respective departments/sections. The verification shall mandatorily include Stores (Main Store and departmental Stores), Library (books, journals, e-resources, furniture and fixtures), Workshop (tools, machinery, equipment and accessories), laboratories, furniture and fixtures, computers, printers and IT equipment, electrical and civil infrastructure, stock registers, dead stock items and all other movable or immovable assets under their control. All HoDs/Incharges shall personally supervise the verification process to ensure its completeness and accuracy. The detailed report of the internal physical verification, duly signed by the concerned HoD/Incharge, along with list of discrepancies (if any), shortage/excess report and recommendations for rectification, shall be submitted to the undersigned on or before 30th April 2026.

After completion of the internal physical verification by all departments/sections, the Inter-Departmental Physical Verification will commence and the schedule along with constitution of the Inter-Departmental Verification Teams shall be notified separately. Strict compliance of this order is expected from all concerned.

**Subject: Constitution of HEI Anti-Ragging Committee (ARC), HEI Anti-Ragging Squad (ARS) and HEI Wardens for the Academic Year 2026-27 - regarding.**

* Design strategies and action plans for curbing the menace of ragging in the institution.
* Conduct awareness programmes and promote a ragging-free campus culture.

* **Duties of ARS (not limited to the following):**

* Maintain a record of surprise checks and submit reports periodically.
* Assist the Anti-Ragging Committee in the investigation of complaints.

* **Duties of Wardens (not limited to the following):**
* Maintain discipline and a ragging-free environment in the hostels.
* Conduct regular counselling and orientation of freshers.
* Keep a close watch on the activities of students, especially during the initial months of the academic year.
* Report any incident of ragging or indiscipline immediately to the Anti-Ragging Committee / Squad.
* Ensure proper implementation of anti-ragging measures within the hostel premises.
